about_the_game:
Welcome to Museum Simulator! In this game, you will organize, manage, and expand your own museum. Earn more money by increasing ticket prices and selling items in your gift shop!

Here are some of the things you can do to increase your Museum's prestige:

  • Explore the Unknown: Send expeditions to find relics of varying rarities, including some that have never been seen before.

  • Reveal the Relics: Once the expedition boxes arrive, you will need to clean the relics before placing them.

  • Curate: Choose where to place the relics based on their type, rarity, origin, or any way you want! The rarer the relics you have placed, the more customers will be willing to pay to come to your museum.

  • Run a Gift Shop: Don't just wait to make money with tickets, sell some museum-themed merch in order to make an extra buck or two.

  • Auction: If you find a relic that you already have or that is of no interest to you, you can simply auction it off for some extra cash.

  • Complete Your Collection: Can you find more than 350 custom-made relics?

Whether you're a lover of history, a fan of cozy sims, or a completionist at heart, Museum Simulator offers a satisfying journey of discovery, design, and curation.

short_description: Build and manage your own museum! Discover, clean, and display over 350 relics from around the world. Run expeditions, auction extras, and boost profits with your gift shop. Curate rare exhibits and turn your museum into a must-see destination!
